description: 🏠 An AI real estate app featuring secure auth, conversation management, & personalized property recommendations. Powered by Agentic AI, RAG (w/ Pinecone), GraphRAG (w/ Neo4j), MCP, kNN, K‑Means Clustering, CoT, LangGraph, and a Mixture‑of‑Experts ensemble to deliver accurate, effective, and scalable AI insights. Also features a VS Code extension!
